dialog.matteroverdrive.mad_scientist.req:
Finally!
Getting rid of that fragile body is the best choice.
The only problem is that I need you to bring me a set of Android parts before we begin.
I want to become an android.
dialog.matteroverdrive.mad_scientist.mai: I don't deal with humans.;NO! I can't even look at you. So fragile!;Are you ok ? You look trapped! How can you stand that flesh?
Ah %1$s, good to see you! What brings you here?;Hello there. You look splendid today!;It seems your left eye is out of alignment. I'll be glad to fix it.
dialog.matteroverdrive.mad_scientist.und: Why would you want to do that? The only way is by swallowing a blue pill. It can be found in dungeons, but your best bet is to buy it from someone. I think I had some in my workshop. I'll have to check.
dialog.matteroverdrive.mad_scientist.wha: You are now an Android! You will no longer need food, sleep or oxygen. You can upgrade yourself with wonderful abilities in an Android Station and you will be able to see and do things you never imagined.
What did you do to me?
dialog.matteroverdrive.mad_scientist.jun: Hey there buddy [§6burp§r].;What's going on buddy.;
You said something about a cocktail?
You-you-you have to help me, buddy, you see.
I have-have this [§6burp§r] amazing recipe, buddy, just amazing things with stuff mixed together, buddy.
It - it's gonna be better than... no it's incomparable, buddy, it's the pinnacle of perfection, buddy [§6burp§r].
But you see I need these things, buddy! I-I need some of that creeper POWDER, buddy and-and [§6burp§r] some mushrooms from the NETHER!
But see here now, buddy! Hey, stop scratching your ass, buddy, it's v-v-very important!
That powder stuff from the creeper keeps its potency only if you kill it with a shovel, buddy.
Yes, a fucking shovel, buddy, you-you have to smash its brains out, repeated blunt traumas, buddy, to get the good stuff!
Now, go, buddy, quickly, buddy, go!
I have all the ingredients for your cocktail.
Ah yes, now let me get these thing out of you buddy, take the burden of your shoulders, let me just mix up a batch and.... [§6junkie scientist mixes up the ingredients and takes a snort....§r]
quest.matteroverdrive.kill_androids.0.in: The are taking over the world! I don't know how exactly they got here, but there numbers are growing by the day. It's seems like there's no end to them. We must fight for if we don't, we will all perish. The fight starts with you %1$s! We need you to help us kill as many of them as possible, before they get us all.
quest.matteroverdrive.cocktail_of_ascens: A Crazy scientist has asked you to bring him %2$s gunpowder from a shoveled creeper and %3$s red mushrooms from the darkest depths of the Nether, for his Cocktail Of Ascension.
Pickup %2$s/%3$s red mushrooms from the Nether
Talk to the crazy scientist junkie
quest.matteroverdrive.sacrifice.title: Sacrifice
quest.matteroverdrive.sacrifice.info: We are the Dark Vail. We have begun restoring an ancient artifact, the effects of which will remain a secret. All we need from you %1$s is to sacrifice %2$s %3$s newborns in the name of the dark lord, whose name strikes fear in the hearts of the innocent. Barry the dark lord. You will be compensated handsomely for your efforts.
quest.matteroverdrive.department_of_agri: To all willing hands. This is a job offer from the department of agriculture. We operate in the desolate world of Barus V and you can image the obstacles we face when it comes to growing %3$s. As our plans for hydroponic farms come to turn, our people starve to death. We are searching for capable parties to aid us in the supplying of %3$s shipments to our citizens in need.
quest.matteroverdrive.one_true_love.info: I'm so happy! You can't even imagine what a joyous moment this is! Merry has finally agreed to merry me. You don't even know how many times I've tried to win her heart. At long last her father gave us his blessing. I know our love is more than enough to keeps us going, but I wanted to give her something special. I was hoping you can find me a diamond so I can put a marvelous ring onto her precious finger. I will forever be in dept and I will be more than happy to compensate for you troubles.
quest.matteroverdrive.weapons_of_war.inf: They have oppressed us for long enough! Our proud people will no longer stand for this. Years of oppression, end now! We may be broken in body be we are strong in spirit. This is where we need your help. It may not be pretty, but war is coming and we need a way to defend ourselves. They will throw everything they have at us. The first step of many, is to build anvils use them to forge the weapons we desperately need.
quest.matteroverdrive.to_the_power_of.in: Before I can begin work on my ascension from my limiting mortality I need to ensure a consistent source of power.
quest.matteroverdrive.puny_humans.title: Puny Humans
quest.matteroverdrive.puny_humans.info: I have spoken to scientist, who is obviously mad, but makes quite the offering. He has agreed to make me into an android. All I need to do is collect a full set of Android Parts for the procedure. Rouge Androids seem to be the only ones who drop the parts needed.
quest.matteroverdrive.puny_humans.object: Collect a full set of android parts
quest.matteroverdrive.is_it_really_me.in: Our investors have finally decided to let us begin human trails. We are all ready to proceed whenever you are. We have done rigorous testing on animals and inanimate objects and the fail rate is well below 25%. We can assure you that everything will go according to plan. Of course there is still the matter of the psychological barriers, we don't know how exactly the Edux got over them, but we are positive you can push yourself to do it. Just step onto the platform and close your eyes.
quest.matteroverdrive.beast_belly.title: The belly of the beast
quest.matteroverdrive.beast_belly.info: There is no easy way to say this, but we need you to die for us. For science! Have you ever encountered strange gravitational anomalies? We can't figure out exactly what happens then matter is introduced into their event horizon. We can see it growing, but where does all that matter go ? We want you to travel into the event horizon of a gravitational anomaly and see what mysteries lie within. Be careful, it might hurt a bit.
quest.matteroverdrive.crash_landing.info: Captain's Log stardate 48940.8./n//n/I've had to initiate emergency landing procedures. My ship's port nacelle is completely fried. I have enough emergency rations to last me for a while, but the watter tank was ruptured./n/I must get out and find fresh water pronto./n/From what I can gather by looking at the star charts , I seem to have crashed somewhere in the orion sector. Last I heard the whole sector was overwhelmed with Edux rejects./n/I guess that means I won't find anybody to talk to in a while./n/To think this happened just before I got to finally visit Emily for the first time, in 5 years.
quest.matteroverdrive.crash_landing.obje: Build a $craftItem and try to hack the terminal to contact the captain's family.
quest.matteroverdrive.we_must_know.title: We must know
quest.matteroverdrive.we_must_know.info: Thank you for contacting us./n/I still find this whole ordeal shocking. I know we weren't on the best of terms for quite some time, but I just can't imagine what my daughter feels right now./n/Emily is quite a strong woman, but she didn't take the news very well./n/I have one last request of you. As his commanding officer It's my duty to honor the death of a fellow solder. Hell it's the least I can do./n/Will you put down the $block I've sent you so that we can retrieve all of his logs. I know he cared deeply for my Emily and I hope there is something in there to put my daughter's mind at ease.
quest.matteroverdrive.we_must_know.objec: Place the $block near the ship at $distance away.
quest.matteroverdrive.gmo.title: G.M.O.
quest.matteroverdrive.gmo.info: Replicating vegetables! That's just absurd!/n/They taste awful, all those replicated stuff feel just like eating plastic./n/No no, we need something different. I just got my new biolistic particle delivery system and I can't wait to test that baby out. I see all these pathetic villagers planting their crops, crawling in the dirt like animals. I just need to get my hands on some crop gene sequences. The thing is these brainless, villagers won't let me anywhere near the crops. Can you use my Data Pad and scan some for me? I'm sure I can give you something for the favor. I had some old android parts laying around.
quest.matteroverdrive.gmo.objective.0: Scan $scanAmount/$maxScanAmount $block with the Scientist's Data Pad.
entity.matteroverdrive.mad_scientist.lin: You don't have all the parts!
